name: Village Slut Transformation
source:
Lily is a timid and shy girl who has recently graduated from high school. She just traveled by train to the capital to attend university, but unfortunately something unexpected happened.

After falling asleep on the train and oversleeping her station, out of panic she runs out of the train as soon as it stops. Unfortunately for her, she finds herself in the middle of nowhere - the station is located near a small village.

The station is empty, her phone is dead, and there are no timetables or workers to help her, Lily does not even know when the next train arrives.

And just when she thinks the situation can't get any worse, her luggage is somehow stolen at the station itself, with no one around.

What should Lily do? What trials await her? Will she be able to return home?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/about-my-new-87949819]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
莉莉是个胆怯害羞的女孩，刚刚高中毕业。她独自搭乘火车前往首都准备上大学，不料途中却发生了意外。

她在车上睡着后坐过了站，惊慌失措之下，列车一停稳她便匆忙冲下了车。倒霉的是，她发现自己落到了荒郊野外——这座车站位于一个小村庄附近。

车站里空无一人，手机也没电关机了，既没有时刻表，也没有工作人员可以求助，莉莉甚至不知道下一班列车什么时候才会来。

而就在她以为处境不会更糟的时候，明明四下无人，她放在车站里的行李竟不知怎么被偷走了。

莉莉该怎么办？前方等待着她的是怎样的磨难？她最终还能回到家中吗？
